name: COMP_012
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (48%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability [F6] and a three-class conformal set [F1] prevent separation; margin call is defer [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 48%, InSitu 37%, Benign 10%, Normal 6% | Invasive leads; InSitu close behind |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot separate three classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 20% reliability (flagged); 90% OOD | Suspect, atypical input flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (false) | Foundation models pick different tops |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Invasive (20%) [F5] | Neighbors span all four classes |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Strongest embedding score (+1.935 contribution, 19/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical embedding score (+0.486 contribution, 18/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable model score (+0.474 contribution, 0/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Counter-evidence in right-half regions (-0.429 contribution, 20/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section composite artifacts caused the 20% reliability score; a recut H&E section is drafted.
- High-risk regions reflect InSitu (37%) or Benign mimicry (contrast case BACH_0284, 89% similarity); deeper levels are drafted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 8**: Verify stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism versus in situ carcinoma or artifact.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 10**: Confirm benign fibrous stroma or fat in the low-risk right half.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Defer superior, medial, and inferior margin assessment to permanent sections.
